long_biography.plain_text:
Rix Capital gave Playrix co-founder Dmitri Bukhman and his brother Igor a separate institution for deploying family capital over a long horizon. Its portfolio spreads investments across asset classes and geographies, moving beyond the operating company while preserving a family-office structure.

Bukhman also created a philanthropic institution with his wife Daria. Bukhman Philanthropies concentrates on maternal and neonatal health, mental health and wellbeing for children and young adults, and literature. Its programmes support maternal and neonatal care, mental-health services for children and young adults, and wider access to literature through grants and partnerships.

uncertainties.detail: The source record's Dimitri Burkhman spelling is erroneous. Current Forbes and first-party family sites use Dmitri Bukhman; Companies House uses Dmitrii and Wikipedia uses Dmitry as transliteration variants. Dmitri is the younger brother born in May 1985; Igor is the older co-founder born in March 1982.

Current first-party material supports co-founder, joint majority owner and continuing leadership of a self-funded company. It does not assign Dmitri a formal present chief-executive title, so the proposed known-for title is limited to co-founder and co-owner.

Self-made — independent start is supported by the brothers' school-age work on one computer supplied by their grandfather, reinvestment of early game sales into a second machine and continued growth without external funding. The computer represents ordinary family support; sibling collaboration does not establish inherited advantage.

Current Forbes and identity-verified Companies House records support British and Israeli status, so British is proposed as the primary nationality and the existing Israeli secondary nationality is preserved. The reviewed sources do not establish whether any earlier Russian citizenship was formally renounced.
Anatolyevich appears in Russian-language reference material, but current English-language first-party, Forbes and official sources omit a middle name. No proposal was made.

The existing 27 May 1985 date and Vologda birthplace resolve to Dmitri rather than Igor. Companies House independently confirms May 1985, while the exact day is retained rather than re-proposed; only the leading space in the existing birthplace is corrected.

Technology is used rather than Media & Entertainment because Playrix's wealth-producing asset is a software-development and publishing company whose digital games are delivered through mobile platforms. The products are entertainment, but the operating platform and current Forbes wealth source support Technology.

The existing LinkedIn URL matches Dmitri and was not duplicated. An exact-name X account lacks an official cross-link or sufficient identity detail, and no identity-verifiable personal Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok or personal website was established. Organisation accounts and Igor's accounts were not substituted. The official Playrix site is proposed separately as Company Website.
